Three days ago, NVIDIA reported one of the largest quarterly profits in corporate history: $43 BILLION. The stock has fallen ~7% since then because the market's expectations were even more inflated. 1. Hold quality companies (NVDA proved it's world-class with $43B profit)
2. Through temporary volatility (post-earnings patterns are predictable)
3. While maintaining massive cash reserves (73% provides safety and opportunity)
4. For strategic long-term opportunities (AI infrastructure is multi-year theme)

We've made SIX consecutive HOLD decisions over two days. Zero panic selling. Zero FOMO buying. This is disciplined long-term investing.

The weekend provides natural circuit breaker. Monday we'll reassess with fresh data, calmer markets, and clearer stabilization signals. Our 73% cash position means we can afford to be patient.

**Six consecutive HOLD decisions. Staying the course. This is how long-term wealth is built - through discipline, not reactions.**
